summary.short_summary: TSG is currently experiencing a positive growth trajectory with an EBITDA of approximately $1 million and a strong new business pipeline, indicating potential for increased valuation. As TSG transitions from an agency model to a SaaS/licensing subscription business, its revenue is estimated between $6-7 million. Coolco, on the other hand, has projected revenues of $45 million for 2023 with an EBITDA of $2 million, aiming to double its revenue in 2.5 years. Multiple acquisition offers for TSG have been rejected due to concerns over client retention, prompting renewed discussions with Coolco. John, a founding member, is looking for an exit in 2-4 years, while CEO Stuart focuses on growth and the partnership with Coolco. Coolco's proposal includes 80-90% of the deal in stock to minimize cash outlay, aligning with their exit strategy in 2027 and a planned AI product launch in 2026.
